title: API 500 Internal Server Error
issue: API endpoints returning HTTP 500 Internal Server Error responses
symptoms: HTTP 500 responses on API endpoints
Error logs showing unhandled exceptions or stack traces
Increased error rate in monitoring dashboards
possible_causes: Unhandled exception in application code
Unexpected input data causing code path failures
Bug introduced in a recent deployment
troubleshooting_steps: Check application error logs for the full stack trace
Identify the specific endpoint and request payload triggering the 500
Review recent code deployments or config changes in the last 24 hours
Test the endpoint manually with known-good payloads
resolution: Fix the identified code bug. Roll back the deployment if a recent change introduced the error. Add input validation and proper error handling.

title: Database Connection Failure
issue: Application cannot establish or maintain connections to the database
symptoms: Connection timeout errors in application logs
QueuePool limit reached or pool exhausted errors
API requests failing with 500 or 503 errors
Database health check endpoint reporting down
possible_causes: Database connection pool exhausted due to connection leaks
Database server is down or unreachable
Too many concurrent connections exceeding max_connections limit
Long-running queries holding connections open
troubleshooting_steps: Check database server logs for connection limit errors
Verify database server is reachable
Check current active connections count
Inspect application connection pool settings
Identify and terminate long-running queries
resolution: Increase connection pool size if traffic has grown. Fix connection leaks. Kill idle connections. Scale database if overloaded.

title: Authentication and Authorization Failures
issue: Users unable to authenticate or access authorized resources
symptoms: HTTP 401 Unauthorized responses for valid credentials
HTTP 403 Forbidden responses for authorized users
JWT token validation failures in logs
Users being unexpectedly logged out
possible_causes: JWT secret key mismatch between services
Token expiry time set too short
Clock skew between services causing token timestamp validation failure
Auth provider or identity server unreachable
troubleshooting_steps: Decode the failing JWT and check iat/exp claims for clock skew
Verify all services share the same JWT secret key
Check auth provider health endpoint and logs
Confirm server times are synchronized via NTP
resolution: Synchronize server clocks via NTP. Rotate and propagate JWT secret consistently. Extend token TTL if appropriate. Restore or failover the auth provider.

title: High API Latency and Slow Response Times
issue: API endpoints responding significantly slower than normal baseline
symptoms: Response times increasing beyond acceptable thresholds
Timeout errors on downstream service calls
CPU or memory usage elevated on application servers
Database query times increasing in slow query logs
possible_causes: N+1 database query patterns causing excessive DB load
Missing database indexes on frequently queried columns
External API dependency experiencing latency
Traffic spike exceeding application server capacity
troubleshooting_steps: Check slow query logs for queries exceeding 100ms threshold
Review database EXPLAIN plans for sequential scans
Check CPU, memory, and network metrics on all app servers
Profile the slowest endpoints to identify bottlenecks
resolution: Add missing database indexes. Optimize N+1 queries. Implement caching. Scale out application servers if the cause is pure traffic volume.

title: Service Unavailable (503)
issue: Service returning 503 Service Unavailable or health checks failing
symptoms: HTTP 503 responses from load balancer or service
Health check endpoint returning non-200 responses
Monitoring alerts for service availability dropping
possible_causes: All application instances crashed or unresponsive
Deployment gone wrong leaving service in broken state
Resource exhaustion: out of memory, disk full, or CPU at 100%
Circuit breaker tripped due to cascading failure
troubleshooting_steps: Check if any application processes are running on the service hosts
Review application startup logs for crash reasons
Check disk space, memory, and CPU on service hosts
Review recent deployment logs and changelogs
resolution: Restart crashed application processes. Roll back to last known good deployment. Free disk space or add memory.

title: Notification Service Failures
symptoms: Users not receiving expected email or SMS notifications
Notification failure errors or dead-letter queue buildup
SMTP authentication errors in logs
Bounce rate spiking in email delivery provider dashboard
possible_causes: Email/SMS provider API credentials expired
Provider rate limit exceeded
Invalid or malformed recipient email/phone in the request
Network connectivity issue between notification service and provider
troubleshooting_steps: Check email/SMS provider dashboard for delivery errors
Verify API credentials in provider sandbox
Review notification service logs for error codes
Test a manual notification with a known-valid address
resolution: Rotate and update provider API credentials. Implement exponential retry with backoff. Validate recipient formats. Clear the dead-letter queue after fixing root cause.

title: Order Processing Failures
issue: Orders failing to process, stuck in pending state, or not completing
symptoms: Orders remaining in pending state without transitioning
Checkout endpoint returning errors or timeouts
Customer complaints about payments but no order confirmation
Database lock contention errors in order processing logs
possible_causes: Database lock contention on orders table during high traffic
Payment gateway timeout causing partial order state
Inventory reservation failure blocking order confirmation
Event publishing failure leaving orders in limbo
troubleshooting_steps: Query orders stuck in pending for over 10 minutes
Check payment gateway logs for matching transaction IDs
Review database for lock contention or deadlock logs
Verify inventory service health and API responses
resolution: Fix database lock contention with optimistic locking. Implement idempotent order state transitions. Add a reconciliation job to recover stuck orders.

title: Payment Processing Latency and Webhook Backlog
issue: Payment processing latency spiking and webhook event backlog accumulating
symptoms: Payment API response times exceeding 5 seconds
Inbound payment gateway webhook queue depth growing
Intermittent payment timeout errors for end users
Settlement batch jobs taking longer than usual
possible_causes: Payment provider experiencing upstream degradation
Webhook consumer service too slow
Database writes during payment processing causing contention
Retry storms amplifying traffic during partial provider outage
troubleshooting_steps: Check payment provider status page for ongoing incidents
Monitor webhook consumer throughput and queue depth
Review payment service database query times during the spike
Throttle retry frequency to avoid amplifying provider load
Scale out webhook consumer workers if queue is growing
resolution: Scale webhook consumers horizontally to drain the backlog. Implement exponential backoff for gateway retries. Circuit-break the payment gateway temporarily if needed.
